pairs.target: dìèrtiān zǎoshàng , nài lěi bǎ yìzhāng miáo qīng de zhǐ pù zài kèdiàn zhuōshàng , huòzhàn ménqián nàtiáo lù yǐjīng liánchéngxiàn , nánbiān huàn chuán de xiǎolù què zhī dào zhǐ jiǎo .
pairs.english: Next morning Nerai spread a clean tracing on the inn table. The warehouse approach was a connected line, but the southern ferry-transfer path stopped at the paper's corner.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天早上，奈蕾把一张描清的纸铺在客店桌上，货栈门前那条路已经连成线，南边换船的小路却只到纸角。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rèn le piànkè , jiāng zìjǐ de cǎotú fàngdào pángbiān , wèn zhè bàntiáo wèihé bù jiēxiàqù .
pairs.english: Tavi studied it a moment, laid his sketch alongside, and asked why that half-line wasn't continued.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认了片刻，将自己的草图放到旁边，问这半条为何不接下去。

pairs.target: " zhè yè xiān jiāogěi jǐjiā chūqián de yìzhàn kàn . " tā shuō , " wǒ dāying hòu rì shāo huí dìyīzhāng , tāmen yào xiān zhīdào jiēkè zài nǎér děng . "
pairs.english: “This page goes to the paying stations first,” she said. “I promised a first sheet the day after tomorrow. They need to know where to wait for arrivals.”
pairs.hanzi: “这页先交给几家出钱的驿站看。”她说，“我答应后日捎回第一张，他们要先知道接客在哪儿等。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu , shǒu què réng yā zhe zìjǐ de zhǐ . zhuōshàng de lù méi huà cuò , zhǐshì yígè chū lái de rén ruò gēnzhe dú , réng huì xiān zǒu dào mù guǎnshì de ménqián .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded but kept his hand on his paper. The drawn route wasn't wrong; a newcomer following it would still reach Steward Mou's door first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头，手却仍压着自己的纸。桌上的路没画错，只是一个初来的人若跟着读，仍会先走到牟管事的门前。

pairs.target: qù nánbiān huàn chuán de yào cóng nǎ chǔ fènkāi , zhè zhāng zhǐ méi shuō . tā bǎ zuótiān zǒuguò de chàkǒu zhǐchū lái , wèn néngfǒu yě jiēdào zhǐbiān .
pairs.english: The page didn't say where southbound ferry passengers should branch off. He pointed out yesterday's fork and asked if it could extend to the edge too.
pairs.hanzi: 去南边换船的要从哪处分开，这张纸没说。他把昨天走过的岔口指出来，问能否也接到纸边。

pairs.target: nài lěi méiyǒu lìkè dá . tā jiāng zhǐ zhuǎnxiàng zìjǐ , kàn le yíhuìer , shuō nàtiáo hái shǎo le dī shuǐ shí de chūkǒu , ruò zhī tiān yìbǐ , róngyì jiào rén yǐ wèishénme shíhòu dōu néng guòqù .
pairs.english: Nerai didn't answer immediately. She turned the paper and studied it, saying that path still lacked the low-water exit; one added stroke could imply it was always passable.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没有立刻答。她将纸转向自己，看了一会儿，说那条还少了低水时的出口，若只添一笔，容易叫人以为什么时候都能过去。

pairs.target: " nà jiù xiě wǒmen hái méi zǒuguò . " tǎ wéi shuō . tā shuōwán yǒuxiē hòuhuǐ , xiàngshì ná tā zài tái jǐng tú páng shuō guò dehuà dǔ tā .
pairs.english: “Then write that we haven't walked it yet,” Tavi said, regretting it a little, as though blocking her with her own words beside the Moss Well map.
pairs.hanzi: “那就写我们还没走过。”塔维说。他说完有些后悔，像是拿她在苔井图旁说过的话堵她。

pairs.target: nài lěi tái yǎn , tā méi wǎnghòu suō , què jiāng àn zhǐ de shǒu sōngkāi yìdiǎn . tā wèn tā shìfǒu yǐwéi zìjǐ fēi yào tì huòzhàn duō lǎnkè .
pairs.english: Nerai looked up. He didn't retreat but eased his hand on the paper. She asked if he thought she insisted on drawing more customers to the warehouse.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾抬眼，他没往后缩，却将按纸的手松开一点。她问他是否以为自己非要替货栈多揽客。

pairs.target: tā shuō búshì , zhǐshì nàtiáo duǎnlù yě yǒurén zǒu , bùnéng yīnwèi zhǐ jiǎo fàngbúxià , biàn tóng méi jiàn guò yíyàng .
pairs.english: He said no, but people used that short path too; no room in a corner shouldn't make it as if unseen.
pairs.hanzi: 他说不是，只是那条短路也有人走，不能因为纸角放不下，便同没见过一样。

pairs.target: yuàn wài yǒurén fàngxià shuǐtǒng , tǒng dǐ pèngdào shítou , yìshēng hěn xiǎng . liǎnggè rén dōu tíng le yíhuìer , nài lěi cái shuō , zìjǐ xiān huà le zuìhǎo jiāochūqù de nà yìtiáo , huà dé shùn , biàn bǎ shèngxià de tuō dào xià yíyè le .
pairs.english: Outside a bucket hit stone with a loud knock. Both paused before Nerai said she'd drawn the easiest line to deliver first, and going smoothly, she'd deferred the rest to the next page.
pairs.hanzi: 院外有人放下水桶，桶底碰到石头，一声很响。两个人都停了一会儿，奈蕾才说，自己先画了最好交出去的那一条，画得顺，便把剩下的拖到下一页了。

pairs.target: " búshì bùnéng gǎi . " tā shuō , " nǐ bié zhī zài wǒ kànbújiàn de shíhòu juéde bú duì . "
pairs.english: “It can be changed,” she said. “Don't only disagree when I can't see.”
pairs.hanzi: “不是不能改。”她说，“你别只在我看不见的时候觉得不对。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi ěrgēn fārè . tā jiāng chàkǒu chóngxīn jiē chū , yòng duànxiàn biāo dào chá guò de wèizhì , pángbiān xiě dāngrì shuǐwèi xià kě zǒu , dī shuǐ qùxiàng dàichá .
pairs.english: Tavi's ears warmed. He extended the fork with broken lines to the checked point, noting passable at today's water level, low-water continuation unverified.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维耳根发热。他将岔口重新接出，用断线标到查过的位置，旁边写当日水位下可走，低水去向待查。

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ jiù shí àn nà zhāng lìng zhǐ yě bǎi guòlái , juédìng cìrì yán nánàn bǔ zǒu , bù ná bànquān shíyǎn tì méi zǒu dào de lù zuòzhèng .
pairs.english: Nerai brought over the separate old-bank note, deciding to walk the south bank tomorrow, not use half a stone opening as evidence for unwalked paths.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把旧石岸那张另纸也摆过来，决定次日沿南岸补走，不拿半圈石眼替没走到的路作证。

pairs.target: dìyīzhāng réng àn yuē sònggěi wěituō de yìzhàn kàn , suàn chá dào zhèlǐ de cǎogǎo , bù dàngzuò quánchéng dìng tú .
pairs.english: The first sheet would still go to the commissioning stations as agreed, a draft of work so far, not a final whole-route map.
pairs.hanzi: 第一张仍按约送给委托的驿站看，算查到这里的草稿，不当作全程定图。

pairs.target: xiě wán yǐ guòwǔ , lú shí lái zhǎo tāmen , shuō tā niáng kànguò nà zhāng bǎ yúwǎng shéng huà chéng jìhào de zhǐ , xiǎng jiànjiàn shì shuí zhème rèn mén .
pairs.english: By noon Lushi came: her mother had seen the drawing using net cords as markers and wanted to meet whoever identified houses like that.
pairs.hanzi: 写完已过午，芦实来找他们，说她娘看过那张把鱼网绳画成记号的纸，想见见是谁这么认门。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi yòu huà cuò shénme , bào zhe túbǎn gēn qù , dào le cái zhī lǎotàitài xiǎng wèn tā néng bunéng tì wūdǐng nà zhī jī yě liú gè xiàng .
pairs.english: Thinking he'd drawn something wrong again, Tavi followed with his board, only to find the old woman wanted a portrait of the roof chicken too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为又画错什么，抱着图板跟去，到了才知老太太想问他能不能替屋顶那只鸡也留个像。

pairs.target: jī búshì nài lěi qùnián jiàn guò de nà zhī . lǎotàitài shuō nà zhī bān mǔjī sònggěi mèimei bàowō qù le , rújīn zhè zhī gèng huì fēi , wèi dào yíbàn jiù shàng wūdǐng , dǐxià de mǐ guī biéde jī chī , zìjǐ piān hái jiào dé zuì dàshēng .
pairs.english: It wasn't the chicken Nerai had seen last year. The old woman had sent that speckled hen to her sister for brooding; this one flew better, leaving half a meal for others to eat while it called loudest from the roof.
pairs.hanzi: 鸡不是奈蕾去年见过的那只。老太太说那只斑母鸡送给妹妹抱窝去了，如今这只更会飞，喂到一半就上屋顶，底下的米归别的鸡吃，自己偏还叫得最大声。

pairs.target: tā ná yìgēn xì zhútiáo wǎng wūyán biān qiāo , méiyǒu yònglì dǎ , zhī jiào tā wǎng néng xiàjiǎo de nàduàn nuó .
pairs.english: She tapped a thin bamboo strip by the eaves, not striking hard, just moving it toward a safe foothold.
pairs.hanzi: 她拿一根细竹条往屋檐边敲，没有用力打，只叫它往能下脚的那段挪。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zài ànshàng kàn , jī wāizhetóu kàn tā , bózi hūchánghūduǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi watched from shore. The chicken tilted its head at him, its neck lengthening and shrinking.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站在岸上看，鸡歪着头看他，脖子忽长忽短。

pairs.target: tā yǐwéi huà jī bǐhuà lù qīngsōng , huà dào zhuǎzi shí , què fāxiànzìjǐ shǐzhōng méi kànqīng tā jiūjìng cǎi zài nǎ gēn mùtiáo shàng . lú shízài pángbiān xiào , shuō zhǐyào bié bǎ jī huà chéng huì zìjǐ fúshuǐ de chuán biàn xíng .
pairs.english: He'd thought chickens easier than roads, but drawing its feet he realized he hadn't seen which slat they stood on. Lushi laughed: just don't make it a boat floating by itself.
pairs.hanzi: 他以为画鸡比画路轻松，画到爪子时，却发现自己始终没看清它究竟踩在哪根木条上。芦实在旁边笑，说只要别把鸡画成会自己浮水的船便行。

pairs.target: nài lěi méi lái tì tā huà . tā zuòzài ménbiān tóng lǎotàitài shuō qùnián nàcì huàn àn , wèn dōngtiān shìfǒu hái wǎng shàngtóu qīnqijiā zhù .
pairs.english: Nerai didn't draw for him. She sat by the door discussing last year's shore change and asked if the old woman still stayed with uphill relatives in winter.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没来替他画。她坐在门边同老太太说去年那次换岸，问冬天是否还往上头亲戚家住。

pairs.target: lǎotàitài shuō zhù , nǎ nián dōu yào bān jǐtàng dōngxī , shuǐbiān yě búshì zhàn zhe děng dàshuǐ lái .
pairs.english: She did, the woman said; every year things had to be moved several times. Living by water wasn't standing waiting for a flood.
pairs.hanzi: 老太太说住，哪年都要搬几趟东西，水边也不是站着等大水来。

pairs.target: zhìyú zhù zài gāochù biàn búbì pà shénme , tā méi shuō , zhī jiào nài lěi bǎ jiǎo biān de lánzi dìguòlái , lǐmiàn yǒu liǎngkē gāng jiǎn de dàn .
pairs.english: Whether living high meant nothing to fear, she didn't say, only asking Nerai for the basket by her feet, holding two freshly collected eggs.
pairs.hanzi: 至于住在高处便不必怕什么，她没说，只叫奈蕾把脚边的篮子递过来，里面有两颗刚捡的蛋。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīng zhe , méiyǒu jiāng tā xiěchéng shānshàngshānxià shuí gèng ānwěn de dáàn . tā bǎ jīzhuǎ zuìhòu nà yìdiǎn bǔ shàng , dìgěi lǎotàitài .
pairs.english: Tavi listened without making it an answer about safety above or below the mountains. He finished the chicken's last claw detail and handed the drawing over.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听着，没有将它写成山上山下谁更安稳的答案。他把鸡爪最后那一点补上，递给老太太。

pairs.target: tā kànguò , shuō wěiba búgòu dà , jiào rén yí wàng biàn zhī tā méiyǎng guò . tǎ wéi wèn tiān dà yìdiǎn shìbushì biàn néng shǎo jiào , tā shuō nǐ ruò yǒu zhè běnshì , jiù gāi duō zhù liǎngtiān .
pairs.english: She said the tail was too small: anyone could see he'd never kept chickens. Tavi asked if drawing it bigger would quiet it. She said if he could do that he should stay two more days.
pairs.hanzi: 她看过，说尾巴不够大，叫人一望便知他没养过。塔维问添大一点是不是便能少叫，她说你若有这本事，就该多住两天。

pairs.target: lú shí xiān xiào , nài lěi suíhòu yě xiào , xiào dé shǒulǐ de dàn chàdiǎn diàoxiàqù .
pairs.english: Lushi laughed first, then Nerai, nearly dropping the eggs in her hands.
pairs.hanzi: 芦实先笑，奈蕾随后也笑，笑得手里的蛋差点掉下去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shēnshǒu jiēdào , bìng méi juéde tā tóng píngrì chúfáng lǐ de dàn yǒu shénme bùtóng , réng shì wēi wēn , cūcāo , yìxiǎo diǎn ní nián zài ké shàng .
pairs.english: Tavi caught one, feeling no difference from ordinary kitchen eggs: slightly warm, rough, a little mud clinging to its shell.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维伸手接到，并没觉得它同平日厨房里的蛋有什么不同，仍是微温、粗糙，一小点泥粘在壳上。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn huíqù qián , tā zhàn dào zuótiān nà bànquān shíyǎn páng . shuǐmiàn bǐ zǎochén dī le yìdiǎn , yuánlái cáng zhe de xià yán lùchū lái , jiù shí tóng hòulái lěi de suìshí jiē dé bìng bùqí .
pairs.english: Before returning that evening he stood by the half-opening. Water was slightly lower than in the morning, exposing its bottom edge; old stone met later rubble unevenly.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚回去前，他站到昨天那半圈石眼旁。水面比早晨低了一点，原来藏着的下沿露出来，旧石同后来垒的碎石接得并不齐。

pairs.target: tā zhī jìxià yǎnqián de jiēfèng , méiyǒu biān chū tā dāngnián lì zài shénme dìfāng .
pairs.english: He noted only the visible joint, inventing no account of where it had originally stood.
pairs.hanzi: 他只记下眼前的接缝，没有编出它当年立在什么地方。

pairs.target: gèng yuǎnchù , dùchuán kào xiàng lìng yíduàn àn , lú shí cóng chuánwěi táishǒu , tóng děnghòu de rén shuō zhe shénme .
pairs.english: Farther away the ferry approached another stretch of bank. Lushi raised a hand from the stern, saying something to those waiting.
pairs.hanzi: 更远处，渡船靠向另一段岸，芦实从船尾抬手，同等候的人说着什么。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīngbùqīng cí , zhī kànjiàn ànshàng de rén jiāng kuāng nuókāi , gěi hòutou liú le yìxiǎokuài lù . míngrì tāmen huì yán nàbiān jìxù zǒu , jīnyè tā dé xiān bǎ zhǐ liànggān .
pairs.english: Tavi couldn't hear the words, only saw people moving baskets aside to leave a little path behind them. Tomorrow they'd continue that way; tonight he first had to dry his paper.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听不清词，只看见岸上的人将筐挪开，给后头留了一小块路。明日他们会沿那边继续走，今夜他得先把纸晾干。
